messages:
maria_product: FYI support just escalated a NimbusHealth report — sustained throughput drop on their Dedicated cluster after yesterday's model roll. p95 jumped from 180ms -> ~1.2s. They hit rate limits and customer success is asking for triage + prioritization.
abby_support: Customer message pasted: 'After the model swap at 02:10 UTC our latency spiked and requests started queueing. Several teams are blocked.' They included logs and traces, attached to the Zendesk ticket PROD-1358.
jay_runtime: Thanks. I can look into the runtime side. Any deploy IDs or canary tags?
abby_support: Deploy bot shows: deploy-bot: Deployed model-redwood/v2.1.0-canary -> dedicated-cluster-nimbus at 2026-03-17T02:08:43Z :deploy: (see screenshot).
deploy-bot: Automated note: canary rollout started by ci/cd pipeline. No auto-rollback configured for latency regressions.
sam_oncall: Jumping in. Observed increased CPU steal on gpu-host-07 and 5xx errors from model container logs around 02:09. I'll paste a snippet:```2026-03-17T02:09:12Z model: WARN kv-cache miss spike=0.43 cpu=78% latency=450ms```. Also SQS backlog grew from 200->3.2k reqs.
lee_sre: Is autoscaler kicking? HPA shows stable at target CPU 70%, but pods aren't scaling because GPU allocation requires node spinup which is delayed ~90s.
jay_runtime: That matches a known model change where memory footprint increased ~15% causing preemption on dense nodes. Could cause scheduling delays and KV cache evictions.
maria_product: From roadmap POV, this is directly hitting our 'Optimize' initiative and also an enterprise SLA customer. Need to decide scope: urgent fix (rollback + hotfix) vs. lower-priority perf tuning in next sprint.
abby_support: Customer requests rollback ASAP. They said hit production impacting workflows and may request credits.
sam_oncall: Propose immediate mitigation: 1) Pause rollout for other canaries, 2) Roll back Nimbus cluster to model v2.0.8, 3) Open incident and collect traces for a postmortem. Can rollback in ~4m.
jay_runtime: Agree. I'll prepare rollback patch and check config that caused higher memory usage (attention caching tweak). If rollback not possible we'll route their traffic to a cold spare cluster.
lee_sre: Need an on-call for infra side to watch node provisioning. I'll open a short-term quota increase for nodepool-nimbus to reduce scheduling delay.
maria_product: Prioritization decision: rollback now and treat perf regression as P1 for Nimbus only. Separately, product to scope a formal perf gating in rollout checklist (include perf smoke tests + automatic rollback threshold for p95 > 400ms). Add as backlog item and link to roadmap 'canary-safety' epic.
abby_support: Noted — I've told customer we'll rollback and will update ticket PROD-1358 with ETA ~10m.
sam_oncall: Rollback initiated at 2001023460. Rolling back to v2.0.8. I'll monitor p95.
deploy-bot: Rollback job started by sam_oncall, job id ci-rollback-7782.
jay_runtime: After rollback, p95 on their cluster looks down to 190ms at 2001023498. Still watching for residual backlog.
lee_sre: Nodepool quota increase applied at 2001023505, provisioning completed. No more scheduling spikes.
maria_product: Good. Next steps: - Product to write acceptance criteria for perf gating (metric: p95 and throughput), - Eng-runtime to add perf smoke to rollout pipeline, - SRE to document nodepool scaling caveats. Assign owners? Jay -> perf root cause + PR, Lee -> infra doc + quota guardrails, Maria -> create roadmap ticket and acceptance criteria.
jay_runtime: I'll also run regression test locally against nvprof traces and include a lightweight regression harness in CI.
abby_support: I'll close the customer loop once post-rollback monitoring window (30m) is clean.
maria_product: Thanks everyone. Putting this on tomorrow's roadmap sync as an action item to scope properly. :eyes:
sam_oncall: Marking thread -> incident-LOG-200102. Opening internal ticket ENG-5821 for RCA.
